description: Generate executable florist recipes (flower formula, stem counts, budget breakdown, substitutions, assembly steps, care) from a natural-language occasion, budget, and style request. This skill should be used when a user asks to design a bouquet or vase arrangement, wants to know how many stems to buy for a given budget, needs a shopping list for a flower market, needs to substitute an out-of-stock flower while keeping the design intent, or asks for step-by-step assembly and care instructions.
